# CI test-completeness allowlist
#
# Every test_*.c / fuzz_*.c under phase3/src/ MUST be referenced by a step in
# .github/workflows/ci.yml, OR be listed here with a reason. The gate is
# phase3/scripts/check_ci_completeness.py, run as its own CI step.
#
# SCOPE: the completeness direction ONLY (every test has a step). The inverse —
# nagging about modules that have no test — is deliberately NOT a gate: the
# sel4 tier (main_x86.c, inference_server.c) cannot be host-compiled and would
# fail it by construction. That is a separate conversation (backlog A9).
#
# An entry here is a claim that the file CANNOT run on a hermetic CI runner,
# not that testing it is unimportant. Blanket-allowlisting to silence the gate
# defeats it; if a new orphan appears, disposition it honestly or wire it up.
#
# Format: <basename>  #  <reason>

test_gemma4_native.c    # dev-only: needs the real ~2.89 GiB Gemma 4 GGUF at runtime (argv[1]); hermetic runners have no model. Self-documented at the top of the file.
test_ggml_integration.c # dev-only: needs external ggml objects (ggml.o/ggml-alloc.o/ggml-quants.o) that are NOT in-repo — the ggml-backend approach was abandoned. Self-documented at the top of the file.
